subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should OpenClaw core add `/mark` as a durable session-state contract with separate provenance and language fields?
rationale: This is a new user-facing command and persistent state model, and choosing whether that lifecycle cost belongs in core cannot be resolved as a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve durable core marks
options.body: Keep the feature only after all label mutation and session rollover paths share one canonical state transition with upgrade and live proof.

options.title: Use presentation-only marks
options.body: Avoid parallel persisted provenance and implement the visual decoration without creating a second durable label source of truth.

options.title: Decline the command
options.body: Retain `/name` as the sole core session-label editing surface and close the feature direction.

recommendation.title: Use presentation-only marks
recommendation.body: Avoid parallel persisted provenance and implement the visual decoration without creating a second durable label source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest ownership of session initialization, reset semantics, and lifecycle refactors in the affected module.
